name: Hybrid Volume Rendering Scheme
aliases: Hybrid between classical object order and image order
definition: A parallel volume rendering algorithm for unstructured grids that hybridizes object-order and image-order techniques to handle complex block boundaries, dramatic cell size variations, and camera-induced load imbalances by bounding the computation of each processing phase.
summary: The Hybrid Volume Rendering Scheme is a parallel algorithm for unstructured grids that combines object-order and image-order techniques to dynamically balance workload and reduce memory usage.
